title: A Promise Spoken Over Embers
intro: You stand beside a desert fire as its embers are carefully spread. Visitors arrive for an encounter in the stillness, and a single message opens a story of promise, surprise, and a future not yet fulfilled.
clues: We crossed the distance to reach a faithful servant in the desert.
We asked that embers be spread to prepare a fire.
We spoke to one who had called out to a flame for coolness and safety.
We brought tidings of a newborn to someone who had passed the age of having children.
We named the promised child Isaac.
We brought glad tidings of a son to Ibrahim, and the astonishing news left Ibrahim laughing.
